scope: No actual repository, payload metadata, copied proof/policy/handoff, or remote reads during preparation
Root supplies payload commit X, sealed push plan/state, independent byte and portable-link/credential PASS evidence, exact remote public/main fixed5 proof and manifest closure
All evidence paths and SHA256 values are bound by actual entry; every independent QA has nonempty typed field assertions
Copy only explicitly bound code/protocol/checks/proof/policy/handoff text into fresh versioned closing paths
Original scientific phase, existing archive bytes, old manifest-covered logical/raw/gzip/descriptor paths and global README remain immutable
No Git/API/forward/model/dataset/experiment operation in builder; output strict closing push plan initially points to verified payload X
Closing receipt binds X; root records final closing push Y locally afterward, avoiding own-commit cycle

entry_schema.remote_review: exact path/sha256, public/main/X before-after/fixed5/plan-bound metadata proof
entry_schema.independent_QA: Exactly6 mandatory roles BYTE_ROUNDTRIP,PORTABLE_LINKS_CREDENTIALS,SAVED_REAL_NUMERIC_QA,ACTUAL_FIXED_CARD_VISUAL_QA,FINAL_REAL_REPORT_QA,ROOT_PAYLOAD_PLAN_QA; completed/PASS and actual nonempty typed assertions; no review authority promotion.
entry_schema.immutable_manifests: Exact15 SHA-bound manifests ordered BASE,V187..V200; old original/logical/raw/chunk/descriptor paths remain immutable.
entry_schema.copies: unique role, exact binding, fresh closing_relative

safe_paths: Reject lexical V112 and traversal before access; component-wise nofollow reads; new writes only
credential_QA: All copied text, closing controls AND independent-QA JSON copies scanned. Private key/AWS/GitHub/OpenAI/Slack formats; only role/path/rule/count, never matched values. Root full staged SHA/size/credential/link QA remains mandatory.
portable_QA: New receipt relative links resolve to declared covered/copied files; fixed GitHub X commit URL only
failure_policy: Preserve partial closing files and outside FAILURE; no automatic retry or overwrite
completed_phase_claim: V200은 source V199의 RAW nativezero8·onehot8 두 동결 상태를 원 query/crop 그대로 실사에서 비교한 단계입니다. Current humansemantic 10모델과 public assistant-weak 9모델의 저장 수치 및 같은 고정68카드를 구분해 기록합니다. 새 C58/C59가 기존 C57의 human D/E 개수보다 나은 개선을 입증하지 못했습니다. 기존 개발 노출이 반복된 비블라인드 평가이며 새로운 학습·source생성·SAM·PnP·좌표·문턱·모델/데이터/architecture 선택은 없습니다. Source 학습에 publicreal이 허용되지만 current/publicheld/COMMON/VAL을 fit하지 않습니다. SELF136/paired21, reference461/manual376 및 source direct-known native6/7 부재를 유지합니다. Humansemantic과 publicweak의 권한을 섞지 않으며 68카드 pixelparity와 실제12장 판독 범위도 구분합니다. 새 native physicalgold·실사 일반화·인과적 개선·채택·전체 목표 해결을 주장하지 않습니다.
copy_role_rule: Nine required COPY_ROLES are a subset; additional explicit unique roles/names may bind plan/state/scopes/source posthash/static QA. All copied text is SHA bound, credential scanned, fresh and size bounded.
required_source_closures: V200 exactphase_result/finalfreeze and final real report QA
Saved real numerical audit and both frozen predictions before labels/metrics
Strict payloadX plan/state + root whole-payload byte-only source postcheck
payload_binary_policy: Only future root-bound publisher bytes; no numeric/model decode by remote or closing tools. Fixed5 remote files are text metadata only.
